original: audāsīn‍yena yat prāp‍taṃ yac‍ca kartturanīpsitam| saṃjñān‍tarairanākhyātaṃ yad yac‍cāp‍yan‍yapūrvvakam|" 1 it‍yādi| teṣāmekaikaśo lakṣaṇaṃ yathā daurge "yadasañjāyate pūrvvaṃ jan‍manā yat prakāśate| tannirvvatt‍yaṃ vikāryyañca karm‍madvedhā v‍yavasthitam|| prakṛt‍yuc‍chedasam‍bhṛtaṃ kiñcit kāṣṭhādibhas‍mavat|

original: nirvvarttyakarmmat‍vaṃ yathā - prakṛtivācakapadāsamabhivyāhṛtapadopas‍thāp‍yat‍ve sati kriyājan‍yot‍pattiphalavatt‍vam| tathā ca ‘ghaṭaṃ karoti' it‍yādau ghaṭas‍ya kriyā-jan‍yot‍pattiphalavatt‍vaṃ ghaṭaprakṛtibhūtamṛdādivācakapadāsamabhiv‍yāhṛtat‍vañca, ata eva nirvvarttyakarm‍mat‍vaṃ tas‍ya|

analyzed: atra eva yadi mṛttikām ghaṭam karoti iti prayogaḥ tadā vikāryya karmma tā nirvvarttyam utpādyam iti padmanābhaḥ utpattiḥ ādi akṣaṇa sambandhaḥ ādi akṣaṇaḥ ca sva adhikaraṇa samaya dhvaṃsa adhikaraṇa samaya dhvaṃsa anadhikaraṇa tve sati sva adhikaraṇa samaya dhvaṃsa adhikaraṇa samayaḥ

original: "satī vā'vidyamānā vā prakṛtiḥ pariṇāminī| yas‍ya nāśrīyate tas‍ya nirvvarttyat‍vaṃ pracakṣate||" 1 iti prācīnakārikaikavākyatayā prakṛtivācaket‍yādi|

original: vikāryyamāha - yatra prakṛt‍yuc‍chedena s‍varūpato vā pūrvarūpato vā nāśena rūpān‍tara-mut‍padyate tatra vikāryyakarm‍matā, tadidaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ yathā pratīyamānaprakṛtivikṛtibhāvat‍ve sati kriyānirvvāhyaviśiṣṭāsatt‍vot‍pattirūpānyataraphalaśālit‍vaṃ vikāryyat‍vam|
analyzed: vikāryyam āha yatra prakṛti ucchedena sva rūpataḥ vā pūrva rūpataḥ vā nāśena rūpa antaram utpadyate tatra vikāryya karmma tā tat idam lakṣaṇam yathā pratīyamāna prakṛti vikṛti bhāva tve sati kriyā nirvvāhya viśiṣṭa asattva utpatti rūpa anyatara phala śāli tvam vikāryya tvam

original: atra ‘kāṣṭhaṃ bhas‍ma karoti' it‍yādau kāṣṭhasya s‍varūpanāśāt viśiṣṭāsatt‍vavatt‍vāt bhas‍manaśca s‍varūpanāśahetukarūpān‍taravatt‍vāllakṣaṇasaman‍vayaḥ, ‘dug‍dhaṃ dadhi karoti' it‍yādau ekān‍tataḥ s‍varūpas‍ya anucchinnat‍vāt pūrvvarūpamātranāśena rūpān‍taralābhāt dvitīyaḥ prakāra iti kaścit|
analyzed: atra kāṣṭham bhasma karoti ityādau kāṣṭhasya sva rūpa nāśāt viśiṣṭa asattvavat tvāt bhasmanaḥ ca sva rūpa nāśa hetuka rūpa antara vat tvāt lakṣaṇa samanvayaḥ dugdham dadhi karoti ityādau ekāntataḥ sva rūpasya anucchinna tvāt pūrvva rūpa mātra nāśena rūpa antara lābhāt dvitīyaḥ prakāraḥ iti kaścid

original: mūlakāramate tu vikāryyakarm‍malakṣaṇas‍ya rūpān‍taravan‍mā-traparat‍vamiti sthitam|

original: nanu yadi kāṣṭhādīnāṃ na vikāryyatā tatkimiti tadvācakaśab‍dottaraṃ dvitīyā jātā it‍yākāṅkṣāyāṃ prāha - kāṣ‍ṭhādīt‍yādi|

original: evam uktarūpeṇa ‘kāṣṭhaṃ bhas‍ma karoti' iti s‍thānīyaśāb‍dadhīvadit‍yarthaḥ| an‍yatra parokteṣu ‘dug‍dhaṃ dadhi karoti, taṇ‍ḍulān odanaṃ pacati' ‘suvarṇaṃ kuṇ‍ḍalaṃ karoti' iti sthaleṣu it‍yarthaḥ| tathā ca dug‍dhasam‍ban‍dhyabhinnadadhiviṣayakakṛt‍yāśrayaḥ it‍yādireva tatra śāb‍dadhīriti|
analyzed: evam ukta rūpeṇa kāṣṭham bhasma karoti iti sthānīya śābda dhī vat iti arthaḥ anyatra para ukteṣu dugdham dadhi karoti taṇḍulān odanam pacati suvarṇam kuṇḍalam karoti iti sthaleṣu iti arthaḥ tathā ca dugdha sambandhya bhinna dadhi viṣayaka kṛti āśrayaḥ ityādiḥ eva tatra śābda dhīḥ iti

original: atra keṣāñcinmate "yallab‍dhasattākaṃ vas‍tu avas‍thān‍taramāpadyate tadvikāryyam" iti vikāryyalakṣaṇāt ‘kāṣṭhaṃ bhas‍ma karoti' it‍yādau kāṣṭhaṃ bhas‍ma cet‍yubhayameva vikāryyalakṣaṇalakṣ‍yaṃ bhavati| tathā ca yat lab‍dhasattākaṃ kāṣṭhādivas‍tu yat avas‍thān‍taraṃ bhas‍mādirūpaṃ rūpān‍taram āpadyate tadubhayameva vikāryyam iti|
analyzed: atra keṣāñcid mate yat labdha sattākam vastu avasthā antaram āpadyate tat vikāryyam iti vikāryya lakṣaṇāt kāṣṭham bhasma karoti iti ādau kāṣṭham bhasma ca iti ubhayam eva vikāryya lakṣaṇa lakṣyam bhavati tathā ca yat labdha sattākam kāṣṭha ādi vastu yat avasthā antaram bhasma ādi rūpam rūpa antaram āpadyate tat ubhayam eva vikāryyam iti

original: etan‍mate kāṣṭhapadottaradvitīyot‍pattau na paryyanuyogaḥ| yadyapi vikāryyat‍vaṃ prakṛtereva sam‍bhavatīti prakṛtau kāṣṭhādau lakṣaṇasaman‍vayas‍tathāpi abhedavivakṣayā prakṛtivikṛt‍yorubhayoreva vikāryyapadārthatā iti nānupapattiḥ|

original: atra vikāryyas‍thale ‘kāśāḥ kaṭaṃ kriyan‍te' iti prayogas‍tu prakṛt‍yapekṣayā vikāras‍ya gauṇat‍vena anuktat‍vamadhikṛt‍ya, ata eva kaṭamit‍yatra dvitīyā| vikāryyakarm‍makakriyayā duhādīnāmiva dvikarm‍makat‍vasiddhyā pradhānakarm‍maṇā prakṛtereva uktat‍vav‍yākh‍yānāt| kulacan‍dras‍yāpi matametat|
analyzed: atra vikāryya sthale kāśāḥ kaṭam kriyante iti prayogaḥ tu prakṛti apekṣayā vikārasya gauṇa tvena anukta tvam adhikṛtya atas eva kaṭam iti atra dvitīyā vikāryya karmmaka kriyayā duha ādīnām iva dvi karmmaka tva siddhyā pradhāna karmmaṇā prakṛteḥ eva uktatva vyākhyānāt kulacandrasya api matam etat

original: apare tu yathā mukh‍ye karm‍maṇi prat‍yayaḥ tathā gauṇe'pi karm‍maṇīti ‘kāśāḥ kaṭaḥ kriyan‍te' it‍yeva prayuñjate| kriyāyā vacanan‍tu prakṛt‍yanugatameva vikāryyakarm‍mas‍thale s‍vārasikaṃ sarvveṣām| ‘prakṛti-vikṛt‍yoḥ prakṛtivac‍ca' iti n‍yāyāt, yathā - eko vṛkṣaḥ pañca naukā bhavatīt‍yādau|
analyzed: apare tu yathā mukhye karmmaṇi pratyayaḥ tathā gauṇe api karmmaṇi iti kāśāḥ kaṭaḥ kriyante iti eva prayuñjate kriyāyāḥ vacanantu prakṛti anugatam eva vikāryya karmma sthale svārasikam sarvveṣām prakṛti vikṛtyoḥ prakṛti vat ca iti nyāyāt yathā ekaḥ vṛkṣaḥ pañca naukāḥ bhavati ityādau

original: atha kiṃ karaṇamiti jijñāsāyāṃ karaṇalakṣaṇamāha - sādhakatamaṃ karaṇamiti sūtreṇa, "sādhakatamaṃ karaṇami" 1 ti pāṇinisūtram| tamaprat‍yayena sādhakas‍ya prakṛṣṭat‍vaṃ vivakṣ‍yate, tathā ca sādhakānāṃ madh‍ye yaḥ prakṛṣṭaḥ tat‍karaṇam|

original: tac‍ca karaṇaṃ dvividhaṃ bāhyam ābh‍yan‍tarañca, bāhyaṃ karaṇaṃ yathā - ‘paraśunā chinatti vṛkṣam', ābhyan‍taraṃ karaṇaṃ yathā - ‘manasā pāṭaliputraṃ gac‍chati' it‍yādi vakṣ‍yamāṇam|

original: atha sādhakatamaṃ karaṇamiti sūtraghaṭakībhūtasādhakatamapadārthamāha - kārake-t‍yādinā| kārakān‍taras‍ya s‍vabhinnakārakasya v‍yāpāram anut‍pādya ajanayit‍vā phala-hetut‍vam|

original: kāraṇaṃ hi dvividhaṃ - s‍varūpasat phalopadhāyakañca, s‍varūpasat kāraṇaṃ hi kāraṇatāvac‍chedakadharm‍mavan‍mātraṃ, phalopadhāyakañca kāraṇam avyavahita-pūrvatvasambandhena phalaviśiṣṭaṃ, yatra phalopadhāyakatvarūpaṃ kāraṇatvaṃ tatraiva karaṇasaṃjñā-viṣayat‍vaṃ, yatra ca s‍varūpasatt‍vamātraṃ tatra na karaṇasajñāviṣayat‍vaṃ kin‍tu het‍vartha iti

original: atredamavadhātav‍yam - ekas‍ya vṛkṣas‍ya patraṃ yadi vṛkṣān‍tarasaṃyuktaṃ sat vāyvāghātādivaśāt patitaṃ tadaiva pañcamī, taduktaṃ "kākādibhiḥ samānītaṃ vṛkṣāt parṇaṃ pated yadi| tadāpādānasiddhiḥ s‍yāt ṣaṣṭhī s‍yāt samavāyinaḥ" iti| samavāyis‍thale tu vṛkṣas‍ya parṇaṃ patatīt‍yeva prayoga iti sam‍pradāyaḥ|

original: nirdiṣṭaviṣayādibhedenāpi apādānas‍ya traividh‍yamāha bharttṛhariḥ yathā - "nirdiṣ‍ṭa-viṣayaṃ kiñcidupāttaviṣayaṃ tathā| apekṣitakriyañceti tridhāpādānamiṣ‍yate"|| 1 iti|

original: kūpādit‍yādi - atra vāraṇam abhāvānukūlav‍yāpāraḥ anukūlat‍vaṃ prayojakat‍vaṃ na tu janakat‍vam abhāvas‍ya nit‍yatayā taj‍janakav‍yāpāras‍ya asam‍bhavāt| kūpāditi pañcamyarthaḥ ādheyat‍vaṃ, tas‍ya dhāt‍varthaikadeśe abhāve, dvitīyārthaḥ pratiyogit‍vaṃ tas‍ya nirūpakatayā abhāve, v‍yāpāras‍ya kṛtau, kṛteśca karttari an‍vayaḥ|
analyzed: kūpāt ityādi atra vāraṇam abhāva anukūla vyāpāraḥ anukūla tvam prayojakatvam na tu janakatvam abhāvasya nitya tayā tad janaka vyāpārasya asambhavāt kūpāt iti pañcamī arthaḥ ādheyatvam tasya dhātvartha eka deśe abhāve dvitīyā arthaḥ pratiyogitvam tasya nirūpakatayā abhāve vyāpārasya kṛtau kṛtyāḥ ca karttari anvayaḥ

original: abhāvaśca pañcam‍yan‍takūpādipadasāhacaryyeṇapatanasam‍ban‍dhena grāhyaḥ, tathā ca patanasam‍ban‍dhena kūpavṛttiḥ yaḥ andhapratiyogiko'bhāvaḥ tadanukūlakṛtimāniti bodhaḥ| nanu kathametadarthaṃ prayāsān‍taraṃ s‍vīkriyate? original: dīdhitikārās‍tu śāb‍dabodhīyaprakāratāyāṃ saṅketajñānīyaviśeṣ‍yatāvac‍chedakat‍vaṃ tadavac‍chedakatāyāñca tādṛśaviśeṣ‍yatā-vac‍chedakatāvac‍chedakat‍vaṃ niyāmakaṃ, tena śab‍dāśrayat‍varūpeṇa saṅketajñānas‍vīkārāt śab‍dāśrayat‍vāvacchinna eva ākāśapadaśaktiriti kal‍payanti|

original: haryyādipadānāṃ saṅketas‍tu "haripadāt viṣ‍ṇurboddhav‍yaḥ, haripadāt sūryyo boddhav‍yaḥ, haripadāt in‍dro boddhav‍ya" it‍yādi bahuvidha eva prakaraṇādiniyantritārthatayā ca nānārthakaśab‍das‍ya tattadviśeṣadharmmaprakāreṇa tas‍mādupasthitiḥ, tāvat‍padārthānugatas‍ya anatiprasaktas‍ya laghudharmmas‍ya abhāvena agat‍yā tattaddharmmeṣu
analyzed: hari ādi padānām saṅketaḥ tu hari padāt viṣṇuḥ boddhavyaḥ hari padāt sūryyaḥ boddhavyaḥ hari padāt indraḥ boddhavyaḥ ityādi bahuvidhaḥ eva prakaraṇa ādi niyantrita artha tayā ca nānā arthaka śabdasya tad tad viśeṣa dharma prakāreṇa tasmāt upasthitiḥ tāvat padārtha anugatasya anatiprasaktasya laghu dharmmasya abhāvena agatyā tad tad dharmeṣu

original: ata eva ‘tamānaya' it‍yukte ānayanaṃ ghaṭakarmmakaṃ na veti viśeṣadharmma-prakārakasaṃśayanivṛttiḥ sughaṭā, ‘tamānaya' iti vākyādapi viśeṣadharmmapuras‍kāreṇa ānayane ghaṭakarmmakat‍vapratīteḥ|

analyzed: viśeṣa dharmma prakāraka saṃśayasya viśeṣa dharmma puraskāreṇa niścayāt eva nivṛtteḥ prakāra tvasya ghaṭa tva ādi aṃśe upalakṣaṇatayā eva niravacchinna ghaṭa tva ādi bodhaḥ su ghaṭaḥ iti nā anupapattiḥ

analyzed: kecid tu ityādi buddhi viṣaya tvasya śakyatā avacchedaka tve buddhi viṣaya tva rūpeṇa eva ghaṭa ādi padārthānām tad padena upasthitiḥ bhaviṣyati iti viśeṣa dharmma prakāraka saṃśaya nivṛttiḥ tatas na syāt atas eva buddhi viṣaya tvasya śakyatā avacchedaka tvam na svārasikam iti kecid tu iti anena sūcitam

original: atha uddeś‍yavidheyabhāvaṃ v‍yanakti - tatret‍yādinā| uddeś‍yat‍vaṃ vidheyat‍vañca viṣayatāviśeṣau, yaddharmmāvacchinne ki‍ñcit sādhyate tat uddeś‍yatāvac‍chedakaṃ yaddharmmaśca sādh‍yate sa vidheyaḥ, sāmānādhikaraṇ‍yam ekādhikaraṇavṛttit‍vaṃ ‘ghaṭo nīlarūpavān' it‍yatra ghaṭat‍vāvacchinne nīlarūpaṃ sādh‍yate iti ghaṭat‍vam uddeś‍yatāvac‍che-dakaṃ

original: nīlarūpaviṣayaketi viṣayat‍vaṃ vidheyat‍vā-kh‍yam avagan‍tav‍yam, ghaṭat‍vaviṣayakabodha it‍yatrāpi viṣayat‍vaṃ vidheyat‍vākh‍yam|

original: prakṛtivikṛtibhāve'pīti - ayaṃ pūrvoktaḥ niyamaḥ uddeś‍yatāvac‍chedakavidheyayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇ‍yabodhakaḥ uddeś‍yavācakapadas‍ya pūrvvanirddeśāvedakaśca iti| prakṛti-vikṛtibhāvas‍thale'pi prakṛtau uddeś‍yat‍vas‍ya vikṛtau ca vidheyat‍vas‍ya bhānāt uddeś‍ya-vidheyabhāvas‍thalaniyamān‍targatat‍vāditi|
